name: Volume Ambient Occlusion
definition: A technique that computes the ambient occlusion of a provided density field, storing the result in a scalar field named 'occlusion' where 0 means no occlusion and 1 means fully occluded.
summary: Volume Ambient Occlusion computes a scalar occlusion field from density to accelerate cloud rendering by approximating multiple scattering, unlike directional voxel shadowing.
